title: How Omio is building the future of conversational travel
summary: Discover how Omio uses OpenAI to power conversational travel experiences, accelerate product development, and transform into an AI-native company.
body: Discover how Omio uses OpenAI to power conversational travel experiences, accelerate product development, and transform into an AI-native company.
summaryZh: 旅游平台Omio分享了如何利用OpenAI技术驱动对话式旅游体验，加速产品研发并向AI原生企业转型的实践经验。原始信息显示：Discover how Omio uses OpenAI to power conversational travel experiences, accelerate product development, and transform into an AI-native company.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How Omio is building the future of conversational travel”。其重要性主要体现在：旅游科技公司Omio利用OpenAI技术打造对话式旅游体验，展现了真实世界中的LLM垂直应用案例。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
